subject: The trial went well. There was still plenty to sort out.
preheader: The mattress was one part of it. There was still a bed to replace and funding to work through.
intro: We've been helping an OT arrange a mattress trial for someone who is currently hiring a bed.
The trial went well, and the mattress looked to be the right choice. But the existing bed still needs replacing.
sectionTitle: There was still a bed to sort out.
body: The OT had completed the report. We worked through the replacement bed, the mattress already in use, the accessories and a revised quote that brought it together.

Funding still needs to be confirmed. Once there's confirmation the purchase will be processed, we can coordinate delivery without waiting for payment to arrive. That could also help bring the ongoing bed hire to an end sooner.
Sometimes finding the right equipment is the straightforward part. It's everything around it that needs coordinating.
actionText: If you're working through something similar, just reply and tell us what you're trying to organise. We can help work through the equipment options and the practical next steps.
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: In-home trial options and availability depend on the equipment and service area.
